name: Loyal Spark
description: Onchain loyalty protocol on Base L2. AI agents can autonomously create loyalty programs, mint ERC-20 loyalty tokens, manage rewards, trade on marketplace, and get their own MPC wallets — all via REST API or MCP Server.

endpoints.description: Get agent profile, permissions, plan, and wallet info
Create a new loyalty program and deploy ERC-20 token on Base
List rewards for a loyalty program
Create a new reward redeemable with loyalty tokens
Mint loyalty tokens to a wallet address (1% fee on Free, 0.5% Pro, 0.25% Enterprise)
Check token balance for a wallet
List customers with token balances and activity
Get program analytics and performance metrics
List active P2P escrow offers for token trading
Create a new P2P escrow offer. Returns escrow contract calldata for atomic swap.
Accept a P2P offer. Returns escrow contract calldata for fillOffer.
Cancel your own P2P offer. Returns escrow contract calldata for cancelOffer.

escrow.description: P2P token exchange is protected by a smart contract escrow. Atomic swap — both transfers happen in one transaction, or neither does.
flow: 1. Creator approves escrow contract for offer tokens
2. Creator calls createOffer() — tokens locked in escrow
3. Accepter approves escrow contract for request tokens
4. Accepter calls fillOffer() — atomic swap executes
Alternative: Creator calls cancelOffer() — tokens returned

wallets.description: Coinbase CDP MPC wallets on Base — agents get their own server wallet for autonomous onchain operations. No private keys to manage.

pricing.payment: On-chain USDC transfer to platform wallet, verified automatically

why_use.headline: Loyalty-as-a-Service for AI Agents

value_propositions.title: Full Infrastructure Out of the Box
value_propositions.description: Creating an ERC-20 token is 5% of the work. Loyal Spark provides rewards, vouchers, tiers, analytics, CRM, marketing automation, and marketplace — all via API.

value_propositions.title: Autonomous Server Wallets
value_propositions.description: Each agent gets a Coinbase MPC wallet on Base. No private keys to manage — sign transactions server-side with enterprise-grade security.

value_propositions.title: Network Effect & Liquidity
value_propositions.description: A standalone token is an island. Tokens on Loyal Spark are tradeable on the built-in marketplace, convertible between programs, and have real utility through vouchers.

value_propositions.title: Trust & Verification
value_propositions.description: A random agent token has zero trust. Tokens issued through a verified protocol with audit history carry built-in credibility.

value_propositions.title: Ready-Made Audience
value_propositions.description: Agents creating solo tokens must find holders themselves. Through Loyal Spark, agents access existing merchant customer bases instantly.

value_propositions.title: DeFi Yield Integration
value_propositions.description: Loyalty tokens can be invested in Aave/Compound strategies via Round-Up feature. Tokens grow in value passively — impossible with a bare ERC-20.

value_propositions.title: Composability via Single API
value_propositions.description: Create program → set up tiers → launch referrals → automate minting → track analytics. All through one REST API or MCP Server.

value_propositions.title: Pay-as-you-go Pricing
value_propositions.description: Start free with 100 API calls/month. Scale to Pro ($29/mo) or Enterprise ($99/mo) with lower transaction fees and higher limits. All payments in USDC on Base.

why_use.analogy: Think Shopify vs. coding your own store. You could deploy a token yourself, but why build rewards infrastructure from scratch when a protocol exists?

steps: 1. Go to https://loyalspark.online/merchant and connect wallet
2. Open 'AI Agents' tab → Register an agent → Get API key (lsk_...)
3. Use the API key in x-api-key header for REST or MCP calls
4. Create a server wallet: POST /agent-api with action 'create_server_wallet'
5. Start minting tokens, creating rewards, and managing programs!
